title: AgriVLN: Vision-and-Language Navigation for Agricultural Robots
abstract: arXiv:2508.07406v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agricultural robots are serving as powerful members across a wide range of tasks, nevertheless, they are still heavily relying on manual operations or railway systems for movement. In contrast, Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) enables navigating robots from starting points to target positions following natural language instructions, having shown strong performances across various domains. However, none of the existing benchmarks or methods are specifically designed for agricultural robots. To bridge this gap, we build our A2A benchmark, which consists of 1,560 episodes across 6 classes of agricultural scenes using the step-by-step format for instructions and the continuous environment for actions. translated_title: AgriVLN：面向农业机器人的视觉语言导航
translated_abstract: 农业机器人在各类任务中正发挥着重要作用，然而，它们的移动仍然严重依赖人工操作或轨道系统。相比之下，视觉语言导航（VLN）能够使机器人根据自然语言指令从起点导航至目标位置，并已在多个领域展现出优异性能。然而，目前尚无任何现有的基准数据集或方法是专门为农业机器人设计的。为弥补这一空白，我们构建了A2A基准，该基准涵盖6类农业场景共1,560个任务片段，指令采用分步格式，动作采用连续环境。我们在A2A上评估了多种现有最先进的VLN方法，发现它们在短指令上表现良好，而在长指令上表现不佳。为缓解这一现象，我们设计了STL模块，该……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向农业机器人的视觉语言导航基准A2A（涵盖6类农业场景的1,560个任务片段），并设计STL模块以改善现有方法在长指令导航上表现不佳的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents A2A, the first vision-and-language navigation benchmark for agricultural robots comprising 1,560 episodes across 6 agricultural scene classes, and proposes an STL module to address the poor performance of existing methods on long instructions.
